paper.title: Fermi surface change and $d$-wave superconductivity in the square lattice Kondo-Heisenberg model
paper.authors: Alexander Nikolaenko, Riccardo Rende, Luciano Loris Viteritti, Subir Sachdev, Ya-Hui Zhang

results.system_description: Kondo-Heisenberg model on the 8x8 square lattice, periodic; t = 1, J = 0.5, J_K = 0.5; 48 conduction electrons (hole doping 1/4); total S^z = 0
results.variant: factored-attention transformer (n_l = 4, h = 12, d = 72) generating backflow orbitals, Pfaffian output with a d-wave seed
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of a transformer-based NQS with Pfaffian output, optimized by VMC with stochastic reconfiguration at fixed S^z = 0 and fixed N_e.
results.notes: Variance per site from the same table, printed with an error (0.00068(1)). The paper writes the hopping as -t sum_<i,j>,sigma c†_i c_j and the exchange as J sum_<i,j> S_i . S_j over nearest-neighbor pairs; the instance reads the hopping as Hermitian (+ h.c.) and the exchange once per bond. Check: the decoupled energy per site at J_K = 0 is -1.5638 (free electrons, 24 + 24 on the 8 x 8 torus) - 0.5 x 0.6735 = -1.9005, just above the printed -1.908883 at J_K = 0.5, whereas counting each bond twice would give -2.2373. Sector stated in the Methods: "The optimization is performed by fixing the total spin projection S^z = 0". Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
